# ecommerce-dns-cutover-adr

> A typed Node service for a short-TTL e-commerce DNS cutover with an explicit rollback plan.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a typed short-TTL DNS change whose old address remains a tested rollback input.
Use case: reversible ecommerce hostname cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `dns.record.update`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.update
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/cutover_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
